captions.detailed: A sleek, light-gray tower air purifier standing on a black rectangular base. It features a large back access door with three black hinges on the right side, a pull-tab filter cartridge nested inside that can slide out, and a top control panel with small, dark gray button switches. The door rotates open on a revolute joint, the filter slides out via a prismatic joint, and each of the four top buttons depresses independently with prismatic motion.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a tower air purifier with an opening back door, a removable inner filter cartridge, and a set of four depressible top buttons. The body should be light gray with a black base, the door should hinge open from the side, the filter should slide out from the back, and the buttons should depress vertically.
captions.factory: Construct the main purifier body as a rounded vertical box with an hollowed-out rear cavity and a bottom black base plate. Model the back door as a flat panel with three small cylinder hinges on its side, attached via a revolute joint. Create an inner filter cartridge composed of a rectangular box with a small pull-tab handle, mounted on a prismatic joint sliding along the Y-axis. Finally, construct four small rectangular button blocks arrayed on the top surface, each connected via a vertical prismatic joint with motion limits.
